titleEn: the engine that keeps the business moving

brief.meaningEn: A continuing driving force that sustains a business’s activity or progress.
brief.meaningZh: 持續支撐業務運作或進展的動力。
brief.grammar: X is the engine that keeps the business moving; the engine image identifies a continuing driving force, with our/their business possible in context.
brief.register: Productive business metaphor, not a separate technical term for a company machine. Explain how the factor sustains activity.
brief.boundaryZh: 重要動力不等於唯一因素，維持運作也不保證擴張或獲利；需交代實際作用。
brief.misconceptionZh: 有推動作用與已取得某項業績不同；不能把形象說法當量化證據。
brief.outcomeZh: 能用持續的實際作用說明業務動力，保留成果範圍。

listening.en: Reliable follow-up is the engine that keeps the business moving: customers return because the repair shop remembers their earlier problems and checks whether the repair has lasted.
listening.zh: 可靠的跟進是維持業務前進的動力：修理店記得顧客先前的問題，並查修理是否持久，因此顧客再來。
listening.promptZh: 這個動力怎樣發揮作用？

options.en: Follow-up supports repeat visits by checking customers’ earlier repairs.
options.zh: 跟進會查顧客先前的修理，促進再次光顧。

options.en: The shop relies mainly on a different discount for each first-time visitor.
options.zh: 店主要依靠給每位新客不同折扣。

options.en: Customers return because every earlier repair needs to be done again.
options.zh: 顧客再來是因先前每次修理都要重做。

options.en: The shop has decided that follow-up is no longer part of its work.
options.zh: 店已決定不再把跟進納入工作。

listening.explanationZh: 記得問題及查修理持久性支持回訪；沒有說折扣、全需重做或已停跟進。

reply.promptZh: 為甚麼這家店這麼重視跟進？
reply.promptEn: Why does this shop put so much emphasis on follow-up?

options.en: It helps customers trust the service and return.
options.zh: 它幫顧客信任服務並再來。

options.en: It is the engine that keeps the business moving because it supports repeat visits.
options.zh: 它促進再次光顧，是維持業務前進的動力。

options.en: Checking earlier repairs gives customers a reason to stay in contact.
options.zh: 查先前修理讓顧客有理由保持聯絡。

options.en: The shop builds continuing relationships by remembering earlier problems.
options.zh: 店記得先前問題，建立持續關係。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都給重視跟進的原因，含目標表達的一句另外獲金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 一家小出版社能持續出書，靠編輯每周整合作者進度、解決卡住的稿件；暫未計算今年銷量。哪句符合？

options.en: Editorial coordination is the engine that keeps the business moving, although this year’s sales are not yet known.
options.zh: 編輯協調是維持業務前進的動力，雖然今年銷量仍未知。

options.en: The weekly coordination is mainly a summary of books already sold this year.
options.zh: 每周協調主要總結今年已賣出的書。

options.en: The coordination has ended because every manuscript is now ready to print.
options.zh: 協調已結束，因每份稿件現都可印。

scene.explanationZh: 協調持續推進稿件，並不提供銷量或全部可印的證據。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個理解最超出這個業務比喻？

options.en: A continuing activity helps the business function.
options.zh: 一項持續活動幫業務運作。

options.en: The named factor is the only contributor to every business result.
options.zh: 所指因素是所有業績的唯一成因。

options.en: The context can explain how the factor sustains progress.
options.zh: 情境可解釋因素怎樣維持進展。

contrast.explanationZh: 引擎強調推動作用，不證明唯一成因或所有成果。

dialogue.promptZh: 同事把「跟進是業務動力」寫成「跟進已令今年銷量翻倍」，但還沒有銷量資料。哪個回應較準確？

options.en: Describe how follow-up supports return visits, and leave the sales figure open until it is checked.
options.zh: 說明跟進怎促進回訪，待查後才定銷量數字。

options.en: Use the number of returning visitors as this year’s sales total without checking what those customers paid.
options.zh: 不用核那些顧客付了多少，直接把回訪人數用作今年銷售總額。

options.en: Remove follow-up from the account because its effect has not been expressed as a sales total.
options.zh: 因作用未表為銷量總數，就把跟進從說明中刪掉。

dialogue.explanationZh: 跟進可促回訪，但人次不是銷售金額，仍需實際銷售資料；不因未量金額便抹去持續關係的作用。

speaking.en: Reliable communication is the engine that keeps our business moving by helping colleagues resolve unfinished work together.
speaking.zh: 可靠溝通幫同事一起處理未完工作，是維持我們業務前進的動力。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再說清持續推動的具體作用。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你替家人的小食店寫一段招聘啟事。店裏每日靠交班時清楚交代未完成訂單，讓下一更接續；你想招願意仔細交接的人，而不是以為只需快速接新單。用一至兩句英文向應徵者說明這項工作的重要性，並邀請他分享交接經驗。
writing.selfCheckZh: 解釋交接怎讓下一更接續，邀應徵者分享經驗；不以比喻保證銷量，也不把交接只寫成接新單。

examples.en: Clear handovers are the engine that keeps our business moving, because the next shift needs to continue unfinished orders. Tell us about a time you helped someone take over a task.
examples.zh: 清楚交接是維持我們業務前進的動力，因下一更需接續未完訂單；請分享你幫別人接手任務的經驗。

examples.en: The handover is the engine that keeps the business moving between shifts, not just a list of new orders. We would like applicants to explain how they pass on unfinished work clearly.
examples.zh: 交接是兩更之間維持業務前進的動力，不只新訂單清單；我們希望應徵者說明怎清楚傳達未完工作。

takeaways.en: Careful coordination is the engine that keeps the business moving when several orders need attention at once.
takeaways.zh: 幾張訂單同時需處理時，仔細協調是維持業務前進的動力。

takeaways.en: For this workshop, regular maintenance is the engine that keeps the business moving through a busy season.
takeaways.zh: 對這家工場而言，定期保養是在旺季維持業務前進的動力。

target.pattern: \bkeep(?:s|ing)? up with the pack\b|\bkept up with the pack\b

brief.meaningEn: Match the pace or progress of the group one competes with or is compared against.
brief.meaningZh: 跟上競爭或比較對象的進度、水平或步伐。
brief.grammar: keep/keeps/kept up with the pack; identify the comparison group and the relevant standard.
brief.register: Race image, commonly used in competition. Keeping pace is distinct from leading the group or setting its standard.
brief.boundaryZh: 跟上不表示領先，也不證明各方面同樣；需交代比較的是哪項能力或服務。
brief.misconceptionZh: 達同行水平與比同行更好不同；仍可有其他弱項。
brief.outcomeZh: 能表達跟上比較對象，分清追上與領先。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Small firms work hard to keep up with the pack.
sources.locatorNote: PDF page 31, table 1, row 3; source book/question/sample not stated where null.

listening.en: The small gallery introduced weekend booking to keep up with the pack, since nearby galleries already offered it; its weekday programme stayed the same.
listening.zh: 小畫廊推出周末預約，以跟上同行，因附近畫廊早已提供；平日節目則沒變。
listening.promptZh: 畫廊想在甚麼方面跟上？

options.en: It wants to match nearby galleries’ weekend booking service.
options.zh: 它想追上附近畫廊的周末預約服務。

options.en: It is the first nearby gallery to offer any weekend bookings.
options.zh: 它是附近第一家提供任何周末預約的畫廊。

options.en: It is replacing its weekday programme with weekend bookings.
options.zh: 它以周末預約取代平日節目。

options.en: Nearby galleries are waiting to copy a service that only it provides.
options.zh: 附近畫廊正等着仿效只有它提供的服務。

listening.explanationZh: 別家已提供，所以這是跟上該項服務，不是首創或替代平日節目。

reply.promptZh: 為甚麼小畫廊加入周末預約？
reply.promptEn: Why did the small gallery add weekend bookings?

options.en: Nearby galleries already offered that option.
options.zh: 附近畫廊早已有這選項。

options.en: It wanted to keep up with the pack by matching a service nearby galleries already had.
options.zh: 它想提供附近畫廊已有的服務，跟上同行。

options.en: Visitors could already book weekends at the other local galleries.
options.zh: 訪客早可在其他本地畫廊預約周末。

options.en: It was bringing that part of its service into line with the local competition.
options.zh: 它正讓這部分服務跟本地競爭者看齊。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都給推出服務的比較背景，不把追上當首創。

scene.promptZh: 同班其他小組已會為報告列出資料來源，你們現在學這方法，仍沒有比較報告的整體成績。哪句準確？

options.en: We are learning to keep up with the pack on source references, without claiming to lead the class overall.
options.zh: 我們學列來源以跟上同儕，沒有聲稱整體領先全班。

options.en: We have introduced source references before any other group in the class.
options.zh: 我們在全班其他組之前推出列來源的方法。

options.en: The new reference list proves our whole report is the strongest in the class.
options.zh: 新來源清單證明我們整份報告是全班最強。

scene.explanationZh: 該項做法是追上已會的同儕，不是首創或整體評分。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不像 keep up with the pack 的這個意思？

options.en: Match a standard that competitors have already reached.
options.zh: 達到競爭者已到的標準。

options.en: Set a new standard well ahead of the comparison group.
options.zh: 遠遠領先比較對象，訂出新標準。

options.en: Improve one service so it does not lag behind comparable providers.
options.zh: 改善一項服務，免落後於可比較的供應者。

contrast.explanationZh: 訂領先新標準超出跟上步伐，不能把相對位置混同。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴想把「新增預約以跟上同行」宣傳為「我們率先帶領本區畫廊」，但別家早已有。哪個回應較準確？

options.en: We have caught up on this service; say what visitors can now book without claiming we introduced it first.
options.zh: 我們在這項服務追上了；說訪客現可預約甚麼，不聲稱率先推出。

options.en: Use the leadership claim because adding the service this week makes our gallery the newest provider.
options.zh: 用領先說法，因本周新增服務令我們成為最新供應者。

options.en: Avoid mentioning the booking service at all because matching others gives visitors no useful information.
options.zh: 完全不要提預約服務，因跟別家看齊對訪客沒有有用資訊。

dialogue.explanationZh: 新加入不等於首創，亦可如實介紹訪客現在有甚麼選擇。

speaking.en: We need to keep up with the pack on response times, though that alone will not make us the leading team.
speaking.zh: 我們需在回覆速度上跟上同儕，但單靠這不會使我們成為領先團隊。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再分清跟上與領先。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你向選拔導師寫練習目標。合奏中其他新手已能不看提示準時進入第二段，你仍要等人提醒。你想在下次排練前用錄音練習入段，請導師下次留意進步，不聲稱已成為最好的樂手。用一至兩句英文寫目標及請求。
writing.selfCheckZh: 把比較限於不靠提示入段，提出錄音練習及請導師觀察；不要把仍在追上的目標寫成已領先。

examples.en: I want to keep up with the pack on entering the second section without a cue. I will practise with the recording, and I would like you to check my timing at the next rehearsal.
examples.zh: 我想在不靠提示進入第二段方面跟上同儕；我會跟錄音練習，請你在下次排練查我的時間掌握。

examples.en: To keep up with the pack, I need to start the second section without waiting for a reminder. Could you listen for that when we rehearse again after I have practised with the recording?
examples.zh: 要跟上同儕，我需不等提醒便開始第二段；我跟錄音練習後再排練時，你可留意這點嗎？

takeaways.en: The workshop updated its booking system to keep up with the pack, rather than to claim it had invented online booking.
takeaways.zh: 工場更新預約系統以跟上同行，不是聲稱發明網上預約。

takeaways.en: She kept up with the pack during the discussion by preparing the reading and asking when a point was unclear.
takeaways.zh: 她預備閱讀並在不明白時發問，在討論中跟上同儕。

titleZh: 一下解決難題的魔法棒

brief.meaningEn: An imagined means of solving a problem instantly and without the usual work or constraints.
brief.meaningZh: 想像中可立刻解決問題、免去平常工作或限制的方法。
brief.grammar: be/not be a magic wand; no one has a magic wand; often used to qualify exaggerated expectations of a useful resource.
brief.register: Conventional magic image. The figurative use can acknowledge help while denying an effortless complete solution.
brief.boundaryZh: 不是魔法棒不等於毫無幫助；重點是仍需工作或其他條件，不把所有困難歸咎個人。
brief.misconceptionZh: 一項資源有用與它不能立即包辦問題可同時成立。
brief.outcomeZh: 能合理肯定幫助，同時交代仍需做的具體工作。

listening.en: The shared calendar helps us see who is available, but it is not a magic wand: we still need to ask people before assigning them a late shift.
listening.zh: 共用日曆幫我們看誰有空，但不是魔法棒：分配夜更前，我們仍需問本人。
listening.promptZh: 日曆有甚麼幫助及限制？

options.en: It shows availability, while late-shift assignments still need a conversation.
options.zh: 它顯示空檔，但分夜更仍需商量。

options.en: It has already obtained everyone’s agreement to every late shift.
options.zh: 它已取得每人對每班夜更的同意。

options.en: It is considered useless because it cannot arrange every shift alone.
options.zh: 因它不能獨自排全部更次，就被視為沒用。

options.en: It replaces availability information with a record of completed shifts.
options.zh: 它以已完成更次紀錄取代空檔資訊。

listening.explanationZh: 有空資訊有幫助，但未等於同意排班；不是全包也不是沒用。

reply.promptZh: 既然有共用日曆，為甚麼還要問大家？
reply.promptEn: Why do we still need to ask people if we have the shared calendar?

options.en: An empty time slot does not by itself confirm agreement to a late shift.
options.zh: 空白時段本身不確認本人同意上夜更。

options.en: The calendar is not a magic wand; we still need people’s agreement before assigning a late shift.
options.zh: 日曆不是魔法棒；排夜更前仍需本人同意。

options.en: We can see availability, but we have not yet discussed those assignments.
options.zh: 我們看得到空檔，但還未商量那些排班。

options.en: The tool helps us plan the conversation rather than complete it for us.
options.zh: 工具幫我們規劃商量，不會替我們完成商量。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都說資訊與同意的分別，承認工具作用及剩下工作。

scene.promptZh: 拼字工具標了疑字，作者仍需按句意選正確用字。編輯說工具有幫助但不能代讀全篇。哪句符合？

options.en: The checker is useful, but it is not a magic wand; the writer still needs to review meaning.
options.zh: 檢查工具有用，但不是魔法棒；作者仍需查意思。

options.en: The checker’s flags confirm that the writer has already reviewed every sentence’s meaning.
options.zh: 工具標示確認作者已查每句意思。

options.en: The editor recommends abandoning the checker because writers still need to read.
options.zh: 因作者仍需閱讀，編輯建議放棄工具。

scene.explanationZh: 可肯定標疑字作用而保留意思核對，不把剩下工作當工具沒用。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個回應最誤解 not a magic wand？

options.en: The resource can help while additional work remains.
options.zh: 資源可有幫助，同時仍有工作要做。

options.en: If the resource cannot solve the whole problem instantly, it has no value.
options.zh: 若資源不能立即解決全部問題，就沒有價值。

options.en: The speaker is challenging an expectation of an effortless solution.
options.zh: 說話者正質疑不費工夫便解決的期望。

contrast.explanationZh: 否定全能速解不等於否定價值。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴說「日曆不能代問人，乾脆不要用了」，但它能顯示大家空檔。哪個回應較合適？

options.en: Use it to find possible times, then ask people whether those shifts are suitable.
options.zh: 用它找可能時段，再問本人那些更次是否合適。

options.en: Remove the calendar and ask everyone to repeat their available times each time a shift is discussed.
options.zh: 刪日曆，每次商量更次都再問每人重報空檔。

options.en: Treat an available slot as an accepted assignment so the calendar can handle the whole process.
options.zh: 把空檔當已接受排班，讓日曆處理全程序。

dialogue.explanationZh: 保留資訊作用，補上同意程序；不需刪有用資訊或把空檔當同意。

speaking.en: The new resource is not a magic wand, but it gives us a useful starting point for the work still ahead.
speaking.zh: 新資源不是魔法棒，但為前面仍要做的工作提供有用起點。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再肯定作用並交代尚需的工作。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：朋友獲得一次跟資深畫家對談的機會，很期待從此每幅作品都出色。你想替他高興，也建議帶一份卡住的草稿及具體問題，會後試改再觀察。用一至兩句英文寫有支持、又不誇大一次對談作用的回覆。
writing.selfCheckZh: 肯定對談機會，保留帶問題及親自試改的工作；不保證每幅成功，也不把非全能說成沒價值。

examples.en: That conversation could be valuable, but it is not a magic wand for every painting. Take a draft and a specific question, then try the advice in your own work afterwards.
examples.zh: 那次對談可能很有價值，但不是每幅畫的魔法棒；帶草稿及具體問題，之後在自己的作品試建議。

examples.en: A meeting with an experienced painter is not a magic wand, though it may help you see a way forward. I am glad you have the chance; bring the unfinished sketch and test one suggestion afterwards.
examples.zh: 跟資深畫家見面不是魔法棒，雖可能幫你看到方向；我替你有這機會高興，帶未完草圖，之後試一項建議。

takeaways.en: The extra hour was helpful, but it was not a magic wand; we still had to decide which part of the draft to revise.
takeaways.zh: 多一小時有幫助，但不是魔法棒；我們仍需決定改哪部分草稿。

takeaways.en: A new title is not a magic wand for a confusing article, though it can help readers recognise the subject.
takeaways.zh: 新標題不是解決混亂文章的魔法棒，雖可幫讀者認出主題。

brief.meaningEn: Pursue each fashionable new tool because of its appeal, without adequately judging its fit or usefulness.
brief.meaningZh: 因新工具吸引或流行便逐款追求，未充分判斷是否合用。
brief.grammar: chase/chases/chased/chasing every shiny new tool; a productive critical image rather than a separate named technical condition.
brief.register: Informal figurative criticism. Shiny means appealing and fashionable here, not necessarily polished or well made.
brief.boundaryZh: 不是所有新工具都不好；問題在追新取代合用判斷，需交代未核的實際需要。
brief.misconceptionZh: 有選擇地試用符合需要的工具不等於盲目追新；舊工具也不因舊便較好。
brief.outcomeZh: 能批評缺乏合用判斷的追新，提出具體評估。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Teams should not chase every shiny new tool they see.
sources.locatorNote: PDF page 31, table 1, row 7; source book/question/sample not stated where null.

listening.en: Our newsletter team kept chasing every shiny new tool, opening a new account whenever a design app became popular, while never checking whether volunteers could export the finished pages.
listening.zh: 每有設計程式流行，小報團隊就開新帳戶，一直追逐每款熱門新工具，卻從未查義工能否匯出完成版面。
listening.promptZh: 批評的重點是甚麼？

options.en: The team followed popularity without checking a necessary export function.
options.zh: 團隊追流行，沒查必要的匯出功能。

options.en: The team compared export functions before choosing one suitable app.
options.zh: 團隊先比匯出功能，再選合適程式。

options.en: The team refused to consider any recently released design tool.
options.zh: 團隊拒絕考慮任何最近推出的設計工具。

options.en: Volunteers had confirmed that each new account could export the pages they needed.
options.zh: 義工已確認每個新帳戶都可匯出所需版面。

listening.explanationZh: 每流行就開戶，未核匯出需要，是追新而未判斷合用。

reply.promptZh: 為甚麼你說團隊在盲目追新？
reply.promptEn: Why do you say the team was following new tools without enough judgement?

options.en: We opened accounts when apps became popular without checking exports.
options.zh: 程式流行我們就開戶，沒有查匯出。

options.en: We kept chasing every shiny new tool instead of checking whether it could export our pages.
options.zh: 我們一直追逐每款熱門新工具，沒查能否匯出版面。

options.en: Popularity was driving the choices while an essential function went unchecked.
options.zh: 流行程度主導選擇，必要功能卻未核。

options.en: We had not matched the attractive new apps against the volunteers’ actual requirements.
options.zh: 我們未把吸引的新程式跟義工實際要求對照。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都給追新缺判斷的證據，不把試新本身當錯。

scene.promptZh: 錄音組每聽人推介新器材就想下單，卻沒先測現有雜音是否來自窗外。哪句較貼切？

options.en: We risk chasing every shiny new tool instead of checking the source of the noise first.
options.zh: 我們有盲追每款熱門新工具的風險，沒有先查雜音來源。

options.en: We have compared the noise sources and selected equipment that addresses the confirmed cause.
options.zh: 我們已比較雜音來源，選了能處理確定原因的器材。

options.en: Trying any new equipment would prove we care only about fashion.
options.zh: 只要試任何新器材，就證明我們只顧流行。

scene.explanationZh: 未核問題便逐款想買，符合批評；不等於已確認原因，也不能泛指所有試新。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個做法最不像 chase every shiny new tool？

options.en: Choose a new tool after testing the function the project actually needs.
options.zh: 測實際需要功能後選新工具。

options.en: Open another account mainly because the app is suddenly fashionable.
options.zh: 主要因程式忽然流行便再開帳戶。

options.en: Replace a tool repeatedly before checking whether each replacement solves the problem.
options.zh: 未查每次替代能否解問題，就反覆換工具。

contrast.explanationZh: 按需要評估可選新工具，與盲目逐款追新不同。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴說「既然不應盲追，就只准用最舊程式」，但舊程式的匯出功能也未核。哪個回應最好？

options.en: Test the export requirement in the available options; neither age nor popularity alone tells us which fits.
options.zh: 測可選工具的匯出要求；年紀或流行本身都不告訴我們哪個合用。

options.en: Keep the oldest program without testing because its age shows the team is not following fashion.
options.zh: 不用測就留最舊程式，因年紀顯示團隊沒跟流行。

options.en: Choose the newest popular app first and check exports only after everyone has moved their pages.
options.zh: 先選最新熱門程式，全員搬版面後才查匯出。

dialogue.explanationZh: 評實際功能，不把反追新變反新工具，也不遲至搬完才核。

speaking.en: Before chasing every shiny new tool, we should check what problem we need to solve and test the relevant function.
speaking.zh: 追逐每款熱門新工具前，我們應查要解甚麼問題，並測相關功能。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再說追新前要評估的實際需要。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你跟朋友合寫一個角色，角色總用最新設備來顯得專業。朋友想把結局寫成買最新工具後立即獲大家尊重。你想改成角色先承認不懂用、向同伴學一個真正所需功能，再完成自己答應的工作；用一至兩句英文向朋友提出這個人物發展。
writing.selfCheckZh: 提出人物由用設備顯身分，轉向承認不足、學技巧及守承諾的發展；不把最新或最舊設備本身當品格證據。

examples.en: Instead of chasing every shiny new tool to look professional, the character could admit what he does not know and learn the function he actually needs. Let him earn trust by completing the work he promised.
examples.zh: 角色可不再為顯專業而追每款熱門新工具，改為承認不懂並學真正所需功能；讓他靠完成答應的工作贏信任。

examples.en: We could show her stop chasing every shiny new tool as a sign of status and ask a colleague to teach her one useful skill. Finishing her promised task would make a more convincing change than buying another device.
examples.zh: 可寫她不再把追逐每款熱門新工具當身分象徵，請同事教一項有用技巧；完成答應任務比再買設備更像可信改變。

glossary.en: admit what he does not know

takeaways.en: The team stopped chasing every shiny new tool and tested whether one program could handle the whole task.
takeaways.zh: 團隊停止追逐每款熱門新工具，測一個程式能否處理整項任務。

takeaways.en: Chasing every shiny new tool left us with several accounts but no clear reason for choosing any of them.
takeaways.zh: 追逐每款熱門新工具讓我們有幾個帳戶，卻沒有清楚理由解釋為何選它們。

target.pattern: \bgiv(?:e|es|ing) (?:a|the|our|your|their) company wings\b|\bgave (?:a|the|our|your|their) company wings\b|\bgiven (?:a|the|our|your|their) company wings\b

brief.meaningEn: Enable a company to develop, expand its reach or make progress with greater freedom or speed.
brief.meaningZh: 讓公司能發展、擴大接觸範圍，或更自由、更快地前進。
brief.grammar: give/gave/has given a company wings; productive wings metaphor, with the/our/their company possible when specified.
brief.register: Figurative enabling image. Explain what new reach or capacity becomes possible rather than treating wings as proof of commercial success.
brief.boundaryZh: 增加發展機會不保證成長數字或無限制擴張；仍需能力和後續工作。
brief.misconceptionZh: 使能及實際業績不同，可說可能助發展而不聲稱已獲更多訂單。
brief.outcomeZh: 能說明具體新增能力，區分機會及已實現結果。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: A strong website can give a company wings.
sources.locatorNote: PDF page 31, table 1, row 8; source book/question/sample not stated where null.

listening.en: A shared delivery arrangement could give the company wings by letting its handmade products reach villages outside the town, but orders from those places have not yet been confirmed.
listening.zh: 共用送貨安排可讓公司展翅發展，使手製品到達鎮外村落，但那些地方的訂單仍未確認。
listening.promptZh: 新增的是甚麼，仍未確認的是甚麼？

options.en: The company could reach more places, while new orders remain unconfirmed.
options.zh: 公司可到更多地方，但新訂單仍未確認。

options.en: The company has already received confirmed orders from every village on the route.
options.zh: 公司已收到路線上每條村的確定訂單。

options.en: The delivery arrangement is only for moving products within the original shop.
options.zh: 送貨安排只用於在原店內移動貨品。

options.en: The arrangement would bring village-made goods into town rather than take the company’s products out to the villages.
options.zh: 安排會把村製品帶入鎮，而非把公司產品帶往村落。

listening.explanationZh: 所述方向是公司手製品向鎮外村落送，可拓接觸但訂單未確認；不是只店內搬動，也不是把村貨運入鎮。

reply.promptZh: 這個送貨安排為甚麼值得探索？
reply.promptEn: Why is this delivery arrangement worth exploring?

options.en: It could bring the handmade products to villages outside the town.
options.zh: 它可把手製品帶到鎮外村落。

options.en: It could give the company wings by opening a route to customers beyond the town.
options.zh: 它可開通接觸鎮外顧客的路線，助公司展翅發展。

options.en: The company would gain a way to serve places it cannot currently reach.
options.zh: 公司會有方法服務目前到不了的地方。

options.en: It offers wider access to possible customers, even though their orders are not yet confirmed.
options.zh: 它提供更廣的潛在顧客接觸範圍，雖然訂單仍未確認。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都給值得探索的接觸範圍原因，保留訂單未定。

scene.promptZh: 一間配音公司找到能用幾種語言介紹作品的合作夥伴，可向海外客戶展示服務；仍需試合作。哪句準確？

options.en: The partnership could give the company wings by helping it present its work to clients abroad.
options.zh: 合作可幫公司向海外客戶展示作品，助它展翅發展。

options.en: The partner has already secured all the overseas contracts discussed in the trial.
options.zh: 夥伴已取得試合作中談及的所有海外合約。

options.en: The company is reducing its presentations to its existing local audience only.
options.zh: 公司正把展示縮至只向原有本地受眾。

scene.explanationZh: 多語介紹增加展示可能，沒有保證合約或縮小受眾。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個結論最超出 could give the company wings？

options.en: A new resource may make wider reach possible.
options.zh: 新資源可能讓更廣接觸成為可能。

options.en: The company’s expansion is certain and no further work is needed.
options.zh: 公司必定擴張，而且不需再工作。

options.en: The context should identify the enabling capacity.
options.zh: 情境應指出帶來機會的能力。

contrast.explanationZh: 可能促發展不是確定成績，也不表示不用後續。

dialogue.promptZh: 同事把「送貨可助公司發展」改成「村落訂單全已落實」，但只是剛開路線。哪個回應較準確？

options.en: Keep the wider reach as the opportunity, and record orders only when customers confirm them.
options.zh: 把更廣接觸寫作機會，顧客確認後才記訂單。

options.en: Count the villages on the route as confirmed customers in the sales report.
options.zh: 在銷售報告把路線上的村落計作確定顧客。

options.en: Describe the arrangement as having no business value until every possible customer has ordered.
options.zh: 所有潛在顧客下單前，把安排寫成沒有業務價值。

dialogue.explanationZh: 新能力有價值，但須分清可服務地點與已確認顧客。

speaking.en: The partnership could give our company wings by making the service accessible to people we have not been able to reach.
speaking.zh: 合作可讓原本接觸不到的人使用服務，助我們公司展翅發展。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再指出新增能力而不保證業績。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你替小型動畫公司寫一封實習申請。公司作品很好，但新人花很久才理解散落的製作檔案。你想提議先試做一小段清楚的入門示範，讓新人較快加入製作，請對方評估而不誇口保證公司成功。用一至兩句英文寫提議及試行範圍。
writing.selfCheckZh: 提議新人入門這項內部能力，以小樣本邀評估；不要聲稱已改善成果或保證公司成功。

examples.en: A clear introduction to the production files could give the company wings by helping new artists join the work sooner. I would like to make a short sample for your team to assess before we expand it.
examples.zh: 清楚介紹製作檔案可讓新畫師更快加入工作，助公司展翅發展；我想先做短樣本，讓團隊評估後才擴展。

examples.en: Helping new artists understand the files could give your company wings without requiring everyone to explain the same process again. Could I prepare one sample lesson for you to review as part of my internship?
examples.zh: 幫新畫師理解檔案，可免每人再解同一程序，助你們公司展翅發展；我可在實習中準備一節樣課給你們評閱嗎？

takeaways.en: A reliable booking partner gave the company wings by connecting its guides with visitors from farther away.
takeaways.zh: 可靠的預約夥伴把導賞員連接到更遠的訪客，助公司展翅發展。

takeaways.en: The new training could give the company wings, provided the team gets time to use the skills in real work.
takeaways.zh: 若團隊有時間把技巧用於實際工作，新培訓可助公司展翅發展。

titleZh: 不是一招解決複雜問題的萬靈丹

brief.meaningEn: Not a single simple remedy that will resolve a complicated problem.
brief.meaningZh: 不是能以單一簡單方法解決複雜問題的良方。
brief.grammar: X is not a silver bullet for + problem; identify the problem and other work needed.
brief.register: Established idiom. Denying a complete simple remedy does not deny that the named measure can help.
brief.boundaryZh: 需分清局部作用與整體解決；不把非萬能誤作毫無作用，也不據此斷言問題永不能改善。
brief.misconceptionZh: 改善一個環節可有用，但仍可能需不同措施配合。
brief.outcomeZh: 能肯定具體作用，指出尚需的其他工作。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: New software is not a silver bullet for poor management.
sources.locatorNote: PDF page 31, table 1, row 9; source book/question/sample not stated where null.

listening.en: A reminder message is not a silver bullet for low attendance: it helps people remember the date, but we also need to find out whether the starting time excludes people finishing work late.
listening.zh: 提醒訊息不是解決出席率低的萬靈丹：它幫大家記日期，但也需了解開始時間是否令晚下班的人無法參與。
listening.promptZh: 提醒訊息能做甚麼，仍需查甚麼？

options.en: It helps with remembering, while the suitability of the starting time needs checking.
options.zh: 它幫記日期，開始時間是否合適仍需查。

options.en: The organisers have confirmed that late workers can reach the current starting time.
options.zh: 主辦者已確認晚下班者趕得到現時開始時間。

options.en: The organisers are reviewing the wording of the reminder rather than asking whether the starting time is suitable.
options.zh: 主辦者在檢視提醒措辭，沒有問開始時間是否合適。

options.en: The organisers consider reminders irrelevant to remembering the event date.
options.zh: 主辦者認為提醒跟記活動日期無關。

listening.explanationZh: 提醒處理記日期，仍要問晚下班者能否趕到；不是已確認能來，也不是只改提醒措辭。

reply.promptZh: 為甚麼不能只靠提醒訊息改善出席？
reply.promptEn: Why can we not rely only on a reminder message to improve attendance?

options.en: Some people may remember the date but still be unable to arrive at the starting time.
options.zh: 有人可能記得日期，仍趕不到開始時間。

options.en: It is not a silver bullet because remembering the date does not remove a possible timing barrier.
options.zh: 它不是萬靈丹，因記得日期不會消除可能的時間障礙。

options.en: We still need to understand whether late work hours make attendance difficult.
options.zh: 我們仍需了解晚下班是否令出席困難。

options.en: A useful reminder addresses memory, not every reason people might miss the event.
options.zh: 有用提醒處理記憶，不是所有可能缺席原因。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都說明提醒與實際時間障礙的分別。

scene.promptZh: 新閱讀角有更多書，但有孩子看不懂借閱指示；導師想保留新書，也把指示做清楚。哪句貼切？

options.en: More books are not a silver bullet; clearer borrowing instructions are needed too.
options.zh: 更多書不是萬靈丹，也需較清楚借閱指示。

options.en: Only the number of books needs attention, because the current borrowing instructions are already clear to every child.
options.zh: 只需處理書的數量，因現時借閱指示已對每個孩子都清楚。

options.en: The tutor wants to remove the new books rather than improve the instructions.
options.zh: 導師想移走新書，而非改善指示。

scene.explanationZh: 新書可保留，但孩子看不懂指示，仍需改善借閱流程；不只看數量，也不是移走書。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個理解最不符合 not a silver bullet？

options.en: One measure may help without solving the whole problem.
options.zh: 一項措施可有幫助而未解整個問題。

options.en: The measure is necessarily useless and should never be considered.
options.zh: 措施必定沒用，永遠不應考慮。

options.en: The context should explain why other action is needed.
options.zh: 情境應解釋為何需其他行動。

contrast.explanationZh: 非單一良方不否定局部價值。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴說提醒不能解下班時間問題，所以不再發任何日期訊息；你想兼顧兩種需要。哪個回應最好？

options.en: Keep the useful reminder and ask about timing barriers, rather than expect one measure to do both jobs.
options.zh: 保留有用提醒，並問時間障礙，不期待一項措施包兩種工作。

options.en: Stop all date reminders and discuss only the venue’s closing time.
options.zh: 停止所有日期提醒，只討論場地關門時間。

options.en: Send more reminders before asking whether the current start time prevents attendance.
options.zh: 先再多發提醒，才問現時開始時間是否妨礙出席。

dialogue.explanationZh: 保留記憶支援，也直接了解實際出席障礙，不把一方取代另一方。

speaking.en: The new resource is not a silver bullet, so we should say what it helps with and what still needs attention.
speaking.zh: 新資源不是萬靈丹，所以應說它幫甚麼，以及甚麼仍需處理。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再分清單項幫助與整體解決。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你替小說寫編輯回覆。作者想讓兩個疏遠角色只說一句道歉便立即恢復多年信任；你想肯定道歉的重要，建議之後加一次守承諾的行動，讓關係改變有過程。用一至兩句英文提出修改，不說道歉毫無價值。
writing.selfCheckZh: 肯定道歉，指出關係仍需透過守承諾發展，提出後續場景，不把一次表態當信任已全恢復。

examples.en: An apology is not a silver bullet for years of lost trust, though it matters. Could we add a later scene in which the character keeps a small promise, so the relationship develops through action?
examples.zh: 對多年失去的信任，道歉不是萬靈丹，雖然它重要；可否之後加角色守小承諾的一幕，讓關係透過行動發展？

examples.en: The apology should stay, but it is not a silver bullet that restores the friendship at once. I would show one promise being kept afterwards rather than end with an instant reconciliation.
examples.zh: 道歉應保留，但不是立即恢復友誼的萬靈丹；我會之後寫一次守承諾，而非以立即和解作結。

takeaways.en: A clearer sign is not a silver bullet for the crowded entrance; the team is also reviewing when groups arrive.
takeaways.zh: 較清楚標示不是入口擠塞的萬靈丹；團隊也在檢視各組到達時間。

takeaways.en: The practice sheet is not a silver bullet, but it gives us examples to discuss with the tutor.
takeaways.zh: 練習紙不是萬靈丹，但提供可跟導師討論的例子。

titleZh: 交由合適能幹的人處理

brief.meaningEn: Under the control or care of people with the relevant ability or responsibility.
brief.meaningZh: 由具備相關能力或責任感的人掌管或照顧。
brief.grammar: be/could be useful in the right hands; identify the competence relevant to the particular resource or task.
brief.register: Conventional hands-as-control phrase. The right people depend on the job, not simply popularity or possession.
brief.boundaryZh: 有合適人手能增加可能性，仍需資源、時間及檢視；不能由頭銜或物主身分直接推能力。
brief.misconceptionZh: 器材本身與使用者能力都重要，不以此說任何失誤都是使用者的錯。
brief.outcomeZh: 能說明合適能力及有限度的交託安排。

listening.en: The donated recorder could be useful in the right hands: Jo knew how to place the microphone and check the levels, so we asked her to lead a short trial before lending it more widely.
listening.zh: 捐來的錄音機交合適的人可發揮作用：Jo 懂放咪及查音量，所以我們請她先帶短試行，再較廣泛借出。
listening.promptZh: 為甚麼先請 Jo 帶試行？

options.en: She has relevant recording skills that can help the group test the donated device.
options.zh: 她有相關錄音技巧，可幫小組測捐贈裝置。

options.en: She owns the donated recorder and has decided to keep it for herself.
options.zh: 她擁有捐贈錄音機，已決定自己保留。

options.en: Jo has already completed the trial and approved wider lending of the recorder.
options.zh: Jo 已完成試行，並批准較廣借出錄音機。

options.en: Jo was asked only to store the recorder, without using her recording skills.
options.zh: Jo 只被請保管錄音機，不用她的錄音技巧。

listening.explanationZh: 放咪及查音量是相關能力，所以請她先帶短試行；試行仍是下一步，沒有說已批較廣借出或只請保管。

reply.promptZh: 為甚麼你認為 Jo 適合帶錄音試行？
reply.promptEn: Why do you think Jo is suitable to lead the recording trial?

options.en: She knows how to position the microphone and check the recording levels.
options.zh: 她懂放咪及查錄音音量。

options.en: The recorder would be in the right hands because she has the skills needed for the trial.
options.zh: 她有試行所需技巧，錄音機會交在合適的人手中。

options.en: Her experience addresses the practical checks this device needs.
options.zh: 她的經驗回應這裝置所需實際核對。

options.en: She can help us learn whether it works well before we lend it more widely.
options.zh: 較廣借出前，她可幫了解裝置是否好用。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都以相關技巧及試行目的支持選人。

scene.promptZh: 舊照片要按日期整理，一位義工曾處理同類檔案、懂記不確定日期，你想請他先示範一小部分，仍保留核對。哪句貼切？

options.en: The collection could be in the right hands with him, provided we keep a clear record and review the trial.
options.zh: 若清楚記錄並檢視試行，收藏交他處理可有合適人手。

options.en: Put the dates straight into the public catalogue and leave checking uncertain ones until after publication.
options.zh: 直接把日期放公開目錄，刊出後才查不確定日期。

options.en: The role should go automatically to whoever first offered a storage cupboard.
options.zh: 角色應自動交給最早提供櫃子的人。

scene.explanationZh: 相關經驗支持先做小示範並記不確定日期，仍需核對；不能把核對留刊後或用儲物條件代整理能力。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不足以支持 in the right hands 的這個用法？

options.en: Relevant skill and responsible care fit the task.
options.zh: 相關技巧及負責照顧合任務。

options.en: Someone has the item but has not learned the task it requires.
options.zh: 某人拿着物品，但未學其所需任務。

options.en: A capable person is asked to test how a resource can be used.
options.zh: 請有能力者測資源怎使用。

contrast.explanationZh: 單純擁有未顯示所需能力，不把hands字面拿着當已合適。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴想因 Jo 有經驗，就立刻讓所有人借機而不留試行時間。哪個回應最好？

options.en: Her skills make her a good trial leader; let us use that trial to decide the wider lending arrangements.
options.zh: 她的技巧讓她適合帶試行；用試行來決定較廣借用安排吧。

options.en: Open the lending list now and ask Jo to work out the trial after the first loans.
options.zh: 現開借用名單，首輪借出後才請 Jo 籌劃試行。

options.en: Choose the trial leader by who can offer the largest cupboard, rather than recording experience.
options.zh: 按誰可提供最大櫃子選試行負責人，而不看錄音經驗。

dialogue.explanationZh: 相關能力支持先試，並不取消試行或讓儲物條件取代錄音能力。

speaking.en: The resource could be valuable in the right hands, so we should match the task with relevant experience and allow time for a trial.
speaking.zh: 資源交在合適的人手中可有價值，所以應按相關經驗配任務，並留試行時間。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再交代合適能力及試行範圍。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：朋友擔心借出的戲劇面具被不熟悉製作的人改壞。你帶的小組有一位懂面具材料的設計師，她願先看鬆線，不會未問便改造。你想寫訊息安慰朋友，說會由合適人看、先徵求同意才修，不保證面具永不損壞。用一至兩句英文表達。
writing.selfCheckZh: 以材料經驗安慰，明確先檢查及徵同意才修，不把有能力當可擅改或永不損壞的保證。

examples.en: The mask will be in the right hands with our designer, who knows the material and will inspect the loose thread first. We will ask your permission before making any repair.
examples.zh: 面具交我們懂材料的設計師看會有合適人手，她先查鬆線；作任何修補前，我們會徵你同意。

examples.en: Your mask would be in the right hands with someone experienced in making these pieces, but we will not alter it without asking you. The first step is only to examine the loose thread.
examples.zh: 由有製作這類物品經驗的人看，你的面具會在合適人手中，但我們不會未問便改；第一步只是看鬆線。

takeaways.en: The old instruments could be useful in the right hands, and the tutor offered to assess them with the group.
takeaways.zh: 舊樂器交合適人手可有用，導師提出跟小組一起評估。

takeaways.en: The archive was in the right hands with a team that recorded its decisions and checked uncertain details.
takeaways.zh: 團隊記錄決定並核不確定細節，檔案交他們處理有合適人手。

titleZh: 在制度或交接縫隙中被漏掉

target.pattern: \bfall(?:s|ing)? through the cracks\b|\bfell through the cracks\b|\bfallen through the cracks\b

brief.meaningEn: Be overlooked or fail to receive needed attention because of gaps in a system or process.
brief.meaningZh: 因制度或程序有縫隙而被忽略，未獲所需關注。
brief.grammar: people/requests fall through the cracks; fell/have fallen; identify the missing attention or handover, not a literal surface crack.
brief.register: Established gap metaphor, often used for support or administration. It can describe an unintended omission rather than deliberate exclusion.
brief.boundaryZh: 被漏不證明有人故意拒絕，也不表示全制度完全無效；需指哪個需要沒接上。
brief.misconceptionZh: 有轉介紀錄與實際有人跟進不同；交接仍需清楚責任。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出漏接環節並提出避免再次忽略的具體回應。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Some families fall through the cracks when services are fragmented.
sources.locatorNote: PDF page 32, table 1, row 2; source book/question/sample not stated where null.

listening.en: The request fell through the cracks when each office assumed the other had contacted the family; both had a referral note, but neither had arranged the promised conversation.
listening.zh: 每個辦公室都以為對方已聯絡家庭，請求就在交接縫隙中被漏掉；兩邊有轉介紀錄，卻都沒安排答應的談話。
listening.promptZh: 甚麼被漏接？

options.en: Both offices recorded a referral, but neither arranged the promised family conversation.
options.zh: 兩個辦公室記了轉介，卻都沒安排答應的家庭談話。

options.en: The family had already spoken to both offices and declined further contact.
options.zh: 家庭已跟兩邊談過，拒絕再聯絡。

options.en: One office had clearly accepted the conversation and completed it.
options.zh: 一個辦公室已明確接下談話並完成。

options.en: The request was rejected because the family submitted it after the stated deadline.
options.zh: 家庭過了所列期限才交請求，所以被拒。

listening.explanationZh: 紀錄存在而跟進無人做，支持制度交接漏接，不知逾期或家庭已拒。

reply.promptZh: 為甚麼這項請求沒得到答應的談話？
reply.promptEn: Why did the request not lead to the promised conversation?

options.en: Each office assumed the other had contacted the family.
options.zh: 每個辦公室都以為對方已聯絡家庭。

options.en: It fell through the cracks because no office took responsibility for the actual conversation.
options.zh: 沒有辦公室接下實際談話責任，請求就在縫隙中被漏掉。

options.en: There were referral notes, but nobody followed through with the family.
options.zh: 有轉介紀錄，但無人跟家庭跟進。

options.en: The handover left the contact task unassigned in practice.
options.zh: 交接令聯絡任務實際上沒有分配。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都指出轉介與實際跟進之間的責任縫隙。

scene.promptZh: 新會員已填入會表，系統寄了收件回覆，但沒有人安排他參加首次介紹，因名單沒送到接待組。哪句準確？

options.en: He has fallen through the cracks between registration and the welcome arrangements.
options.zh: 他在登記與迎新安排之間被漏接。

options.en: He chose not to attend after the welcome team offered a confirmed time.
options.zh: 接待組提出確定時間後，他選擇不參加。

options.en: His form is still waiting to enter the registration system, rather than waiting for a welcome arrangement.
options.zh: 他的表仍等進入登記系統，不是等迎新安排。

scene.explanationZh: 已收表與安排介紹是不同階段；資料未交接使迎新漏接，不是仍未登記或會員拒已給時間。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不像 fall through the cracks？

options.en: A request goes unattended because two teams assume the other will handle it.
options.zh: 兩隊各以為對方會處理，請求無人跟。

options.en: A request is considered, answered clearly and declined for a stated reason.
options.zh: 請求被考慮、清楚回覆，因列明理由而婉拒。

options.en: Someone misses support because the handover did not reach the next worker.
options.zh: 交接未到下一位工作者，某人沒獲支援。

contrast.explanationZh: 有考慮並回覆的拒絕不等於被制度漏掉。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴認為有轉介筆記便可結案，但還沒人跟家庭談。哪個回應最好？

options.en: Check who will make contact and confirm the family receives it before closing the follow-up.
options.zh: 結束跟進前，核誰聯絡，並確認家庭有收到。

options.en: Close the follow-up when the note is filed, and let the family begin a new request if nobody contacts them.
options.zh: 筆記歸檔便結跟進，若沒人聯絡，讓家庭重新提出請求。

options.en: Send the same referral to both offices again without agreeing which will arrange the conversation.
options.zh: 再把同一轉介寄兩邊，不議哪邊安排談話。

dialogue.explanationZh: 需接上實際聯絡責任，不能用筆記取代接觸或重寄仍不分工。

speaking.en: We need to check the handover so that a request does not fall through the cracks between the two teams.
speaking.zh: 我們需核交接，免請求在兩隊之間的縫隙被漏掉。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再指出漏接與實際跟進的分別。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：小組選故事主題時只聽會上搶先發言的人，一位寫得很細但不習慣即場說話的成員一直沒被問意見。你想向組長提議讓大家會前可私下交短想法，會上同樣考慮，不把安靜當沒想法。用一至兩句英文說明需要及做法。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出只聽即場聲音會漏意見，提供會前書面及同等考慮，不把安靜推成沒想法或替成員代填。

examples.en: Quieter members can fall through the cracks when we choose only from ideas spoken aloud at the meeting. Could we invite short written suggestions beforehand and consider them alongside the spoken ones?
examples.zh: 只從會上說出的想法選，較安靜成員可能被漏掉；可否會前邀短書面建議，跟口頭建議一同考慮？

examples.en: I do not want someone’s ideas to fall through the cracks because they need time to write. Let us offer a private way to send a short suggestion before we discuss the theme.
examples.zh: 我不想因某人需時間寫，想法便被漏掉；討論主題前，提供私下交短建議的方法吧。

takeaways.en: The application fell through the cracks after it was passed between departments without a named contact.
takeaways.zh: 申請在部門間轉交卻無具名聯絡人後，被漏接了。

takeaways.en: A short follow-up helped us notice which questions were falling through the cracks in the busy discussion.
takeaways.zh: 簡短跟進幫我們看到，繁忙討論中哪些問題正被漏掉。

titleZh: 支援陷入困境者的社會安全網

brief.meaningEn: A system of social support intended to protect people or households facing serious difficulty or lack of other help.
brief.meaningZh: 旨在保障陷入嚴重困難或缺少其他幫助的人及家庭的社會支援制度。
brief.grammar: a/the social safety net; strengthen/access/fall through the social safety net; the specialised social-support noun chunk, not any individual backup plan.
brief.register: Established social-policy expression extending the safety-net image. Details of actual programmes vary; this lesson interprets fictional support descriptions.
brief.boundaryZh: 有制度不代表人人已獲支援或所有需要都解決，亦不等於一人的私人後備；需看具體描述的可用幫助。
brief.misconceptionZh: 制度存在、知道可求助及實際接上支援是不同環節。
brief.outcomeZh: 能解釋社會支援的作用，區分制度與個人後備或已獲服務。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: A strong social safety net helps households in crisis.
sources.locatorNote: PDF page 32, table 1, row 4; source book/question/sample not stated where null.

listening.en: In the fictional town, the social safety net included temporary household support and a place to ask for help, but the report found that some residents did not know where to begin.
listening.zh: 在虛構城鎮，社會安全網包括暫時家庭支援及求助地點，但報告發現一些居民不知道從何開始。
listening.promptZh: 制度有甚麼，仍有甚麼問題？

options.en: Support and a contact point exist, while some residents lack a clear way to start seeking help.
options.zh: 有支援及聯絡點，但一些居民不清楚怎開始求助。

options.en: The report confirms every resident has already received the support they need.
options.zh: 報告確認每位居民已收所需支援。

options.en: The town uses the phrase only for each resident’s private list of spare belongings.
options.zh: 城鎮只用這詞指各居民的私人備用物品清單。

options.en: The report says the town has no place where residents can ask about support.
options.zh: 報告說城鎮沒有讓居民問支援的地點。

listening.explanationZh: 制度與聯絡點已描述，開始求助的資訊仍有落差，未確認人人已獲服務。

reply.promptZh: 報告指城鎮的社會支援仍需改善甚麼？
reply.promptEn: What does the report say still needs improving in the town’s support?

options.en: Some residents need a clearer explanation of where to begin asking for help.
options.zh: 一些居民需較清楚知道從何開始求助。

options.en: The social safety net exists, but people need to know how to approach it.
options.zh: 社會安全網存在，但大家需知道怎接觸。

options.en: The support needs to be easier to find, not just listed as available.
options.zh: 支援需較易找到，不只列作可用。

options.en: The first point of contact is unclear to some of the people it is meant to help.
options.zh: 制度旨在幫的人中，有一些不清楚首個聯絡點。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都指出可用制度與居民找到求助起點之間的資訊落差。

scene.promptZh: 故事中的居民失去收入後，可向公共支援中心了解暫時援助；故事未交代個案是否已獲批。你想描述制度而非私人積蓄。哪句準確？

options.en: The town’s social safety net offers a route to temporary help, though this person’s outcome is not yet stated.
options.zh: 城鎮的社會安全網提供尋求暫時幫助的途徑，但這人的結果尚未交代。

options.en: The phrase describes only money the resident had personally put aside.
options.zh: 詞組只描述居民個人之前儲下的錢。

options.en: The account confirms that the centre has already approved this resident’s request.
options.zh: 敘述確認中心已批這居民的請求。

scene.explanationZh: 公共支援途徑符合社會制度，不是只私人儲備；可求助未等於已獲批。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不像本課 social safety net？

options.en: A public support system intended to help households in serious difficulty.
options.zh: 旨在幫嚴重困難家庭的公共支援制度。

options.en: One household’s own emergency savings, kept privately for its future expenses.
options.zh: 一戶家庭為未來開支私下保留的緊急儲蓄。

options.en: A coordinated system offering assistance when people lack other support.
options.zh: 人在缺其他支援時提供幫助的協調制度。

contrast.explanationZh: 私人家庭儲備可能有幫助，但不是本課由社會支援制度提供幫助的專門詞組；需分清來源及安排。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴想因城鎮有支援中心，就刪報告中「有人不知從何求助」的發現。哪個回應最好？

options.en: Keep both points: the social safety net exists, and the route to it needs to be clearer for some residents.
options.zh: 保留兩點：社會安全網存在，一些居民接觸途徑需更清楚。

options.en: Describe the contact route only from the staff’s view, since residents can ask once they locate the centre.
options.zh: 只從職員角度描述聯絡途徑，因居民找到中心後便可問。

options.en: Replace the support explanation with advice to rely only on private savings.
options.zh: 把制度說明換成只依靠私人儲蓄的建議。

dialogue.explanationZh: 有中心不取消資訊落差，需保留使用者如何找到求助起點，不轉成私人後備建議。

speaking.en: A social safety net can provide support during serious difficulty, but people still need a clear way to find the help described.
speaking.zh: 社會安全網可在嚴重困難時提供支援，但大家仍需清楚知道怎找到所述幫助。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再分清社會制度與接觸支援的途徑。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你編一齣虛構短劇的節目註解。觀眾以為主角遇困難後獲幫助，只因一位富裕朋友送禮；劇情其實寫她透過公共支援制度維持基本生活，再逐步重新安排工作。用一至兩句英文澄清劇中幫助來源，不加入真實申請條件或保證她全部問題已解。
writing.selfCheckZh: 把支援來源說成劇中的公共制度，分清私人禮物及基本需要，保留下一步難處，不加入真實福利規則。

examples.en: The character’s support comes from the town’s social safety net, not a private gift from a wealthy friend. The play shows her meeting basic needs while she begins to plan her work again.
examples.zh: 角色支援來自城鎮的社會安全網，不是富友私人送禮；劇寫她維持基本需要，同時開始重新規劃工作。

examples.en: The social safety net gives her temporary support in the story, rather than a sudden personal fortune. Her next steps remain difficult, so the ending does not claim that every problem is solved.
examples.zh: 故事中，社會安全網給她暫時支援，而非突得私人財富；下一步仍困難，所以結局不稱每個問題已解。

takeaways.en: The report described a social safety net that helped households through a temporary loss of income.
takeaways.zh: 報告描述一個在家庭暫時失收入時提供幫助的社會安全網。

takeaways.en: In the story, neighbours asked how the social safety net could become easier for isolated residents to reach.
takeaways.zh: 故事中，鄰里問怎讓較孤立居民更易接觸社會安全網。

brief.meaningEn: In the actual local situation where work happens, rather than only in plans or distant descriptions.
brief.meaningZh: 在工作發生的當地實際情況，而非只在計劃或遠方描述中。
brief.grammar: conditions/people/work on the ground; find out what happens on the ground; this operational/local sense differs from physical position on a floor.
brief.register: Established practical/local phrase, often used in reports. Local information can complement wider planning, not automatically replace all other evidence.
brief.boundaryZh: 親臨不代表看見全貌，計劃也不必全錯；需交代觀察範圍及實際需要。
brief.misconceptionZh: 圖上可行與當地可行需接起，也不因地圖有用就省實際了解。
brief.outcomeZh: 能用具體當地觀察補充計劃，保留範圍與待核。

listening.en: The delivery plan looked clear on the map, but the team on the ground found that market stalls narrowed the entrance each morning; they asked to test a later arrival before changing the whole route.
listening.zh: 地圖上的送貨計劃看來清楚，但當地團隊發現每天早上攤檔使入口變窄；他們請先試較晚到達，再決定是否改整條路。
listening.promptZh: 當地觀察帶來甚麼建議？

options.en: Morning stalls affect access, so the team wants to test a later arrival before a larger route change.
options.zh: 早上攤檔影響通行，所以團隊想先試較晚到達，再作較大改路。

options.en: The map already recorded how wide the entrance stayed during every market session.
options.zh: 地圖已記每次市集期間入口維持多闊。

options.en: The team has permanently cancelled all deliveries to the market.
options.zh: 團隊已永久取消到市集的所有送貨。

options.en: The entrance is equally restricted throughout the day, so arrival time cannot affect access.
options.zh: 入口全天同樣受限，所以到達時間不能影響通行。

listening.explanationZh: 所給限制是每日早上的攤檔，團隊想先試較晚到達；不是全天已確定一樣，也未決永久取消。

reply.promptZh: 為甚麼團隊想先試較晚到達？
reply.promptEn: Why does the team want to test a later arrival?

options.en: The entrance becomes narrower when the morning stalls are operating.
options.zh: 早上攤檔營運時入口變窄。

options.en: The team on the ground found a morning access problem that the map alone did not show.
options.zh: 當地團隊發現單看地圖沒顯示的早上通行問題。

options.en: A later arrival may avoid the period when stalls limit the entrance.
options.zh: 較晚到達可能避開攤檔限制入口的時段。

options.en: The proposal responds to actual market conditions rather than only the drawn route.
options.zh: 建議回應實際市集情況，不只圖上路線。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都以早上市集通行情況解釋試較晚時間。

scene.promptZh: 服務中心把排隊指示印成大字後，接待員現場仍見訪客不知道在哪取號，想加一個入口示範，不只改紙張。哪句貼切？

options.en: Feedback from staff on the ground suggests that visitors need help finding the ticket point.
options.zh: 當地接待職員的回饋顯示訪客需幫忙找取號處。

options.en: The larger text has already resolved the problem of finding where to take a ticket.
options.zh: 較大字體已解決找取號處問題。

options.en: The main finding concerns how the sign looks in the printed design file, not visitors’ actions.
options.zh: 主要發現關印刷設計檔中標示外觀，而非訪客行動。

scene.explanationZh: 現場行動提供取號處問題，不只是檔案外觀或已解決。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不像 on the ground 的本課用法？

options.en: A local worker reports how visitors actually enter the centre.
options.zh: 當地工作者報訪客實際怎入中心。

options.en: A narrator describes a dropped pencil resting on the floor.
options.zh: 敘述者描述掉下的鉛筆在地板上。

options.en: A plan is reviewed against conditions where the work takes place.
options.zh: 按工作當地情況檢視計劃。

contrast.explanationZh: 地板上的位置是字面，與當地實際情況的用法不同。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴想因地圖路線畫得清楚，就不問當地團隊每天入口是否可用。哪個回應最好？

options.en: Keep the map and check the conditions on the ground, since morning access may differ from the drawing.
options.zh: 保留地圖並查當地情況，因早上通行可能跟圖上不同。

options.en: Plan the arrival from the drawn route alone and ask the local team only if a delivery fails.
options.zh: 只按圖上路線安排到達，送貨失敗才問當地團隊。

options.en: Discard the whole map before finding out whether a change of arrival time would address the narrow entrance.
options.zh: 未了解改到達時間能否處理窄入口，就丟整張地圖。

dialogue.explanationZh: 地圖及當地資訊可互補，先查限制再選改動，不等失敗或未核便全棄。

speaking.en: We should ask the people on the ground how the plan fits the conditions they face each day.
speaking.zh: 我們應問當地工作的人，計劃怎配合他們每天面對的情況。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再連結當地觀察及計劃。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你替小刊訪問一位海邊清潔義工。遠方讀者只看到「每周清潔一次」的簡表，你想請她說一次真實工作怎因潮汐及遊人改動，讓文章有當地經驗；不把一人經驗說成全海岸都一樣。用一至兩句英文寫訪問邀請。
writing.selfCheckZh: 邀講一場具體清潔及當天條件，把頻率表補成當地經驗，不由一人一次概括全部地方。

examples.en: I would like to hear what the weekly cleanup is like on the ground, including how the tide and visitors affect your work. Could you describe one actual session rather than speak for the whole coast?
examples.zh: 我想聽每周清潔在當地實際怎樣，包括潮汐及遊人怎影響工作；可否講一次真實活動，不替整條海岸概括？

examples.en: The timetable tells readers how often the cleanup happens, but your experience on the ground could show what a session involves. Would you share one example of adapting the work to the conditions that day?
examples.zh: 時間表告訴讀者清潔頻率，但你的當地經驗可顯示一次涉及甚麼；可否分享一次按當天情況調工作的例子？

takeaways.en: The volunteers on the ground explained why the entrance needed a different welcome sign during busy periods.
takeaways.zh: 當地義工解釋繁忙時段入口為何需不同迎新標示。

takeaways.en: We compared the proposed timetable with what was happening on the ground before agreeing on a trial.
takeaways.zh: 議定試行前，我們把所提時間表與當地實況比較。

titleEn: a good heart alone is not enough

target.pattern: \ba good heart alone is not enough\b

brief.meaningEn: Kind intentions need to be accompanied by the skills, judgement or action the situation requires.
brief.meaningZh: 善意仍需配合情況所需的技巧、判斷或行動。
brief.grammar: a good heart alone is not enough + for/to...; heart stands for kindness, with alone limiting the claim.
brief.register: Productive figurative statement, not a medical judgement. It acknowledges good intentions while identifying something else necessary.
brief.boundaryZh: 不是說善意沒價值，亦不以結果不佳推人沒有善心；需說明還缺哪項能力、資訊或行動。
brief.misconceptionZh: 有意幫忙可與需先問清或學方法並存，不能把熱心當已懂對方需要。
brief.outcomeZh: 能尊重善意並指出下一項所需做法。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.expression: a good heart alone is not enough
sources.sentence: In public service, a good heart alone is not enough.
sources.locatorNote: PDF page 32, table 1, row 8; source book/question/sample not stated where null.

listening.en: The volunteer wanted to restore the faded photograph, but a good heart alone is not enough: she asked an experienced archivist how to assess it before touching the damaged surface.
listening.zh: 義工想修復褪色照片，但只有好心還不夠；觸碰受損表面前，她問有經驗檔案員怎評估。
listening.promptZh: 善意以外，她做了甚麼？

options.en: She sought relevant expertise before working on the damaged photograph.
options.zh: 她處理受損照片前，尋求相關專業知識。

options.en: She completed the restoration before asking how to assess the damage.
options.zh: 她先完成修復，才問怎評估損壞。

options.en: She asked only for permission to use the photograph, rather than advice on assessing its damage.
options.zh: 她只問使用照片的許可，沒有問評估損壞的意見。

options.en: She gave the photograph to someone chosen only for offering the quickest result.
options.zh: 她只按誰承諾最快結果，把照片交出去。

listening.explanationZh: 她先問有經驗檔案員如何評估受損表面，是尋技術判斷，不是只問使用許可，也不是已修好或只按快承諾交人。

reply.promptZh: 為甚麼義工先問檔案員，而不立即修照片？
reply.promptEn: Why did the volunteer ask the archivist before trying to restore the photograph?

options.en: She needed to understand the damage before touching the surface.
options.zh: 她需先理解損壞，才碰表面。

options.en: A good heart alone is not enough; she needed the relevant assessment skills too.
options.zh: 只有好心還不夠；她也需相關評估技巧。

options.en: Wanting to help did not tell her which restoration step would be suitable.
options.zh: 想幫忙沒有告訴她哪項修復步驟合適。

options.en: The archivist’s experience could guide her before she risked changing the damaged surface.
options.zh: 冒險改動受損表面前，檔案員經驗可給指引。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都以評估所需知識解釋先問，不否定善意。

scene.promptZh: 你想幫新同學找課室，但不熟新校舍；你先承認不清楚，陪他到詢問處，而非隨便指路。哪句貼切？

options.en: A good heart alone is not enough; checking the route makes the help more reliable.
options.zh: 只有好心還不夠；查路線令幫助較可靠。

options.en: The helpful step is to give a confident direction before finding out where the room is.
options.zh: 有幫助的步驟是未知道課室在哪便自信指路。

options.en: You check only the building number and assume any entrance will lead the student to the room.
options.zh: 你只核樓號，便假定任何入口都能讓學生到課室。

scene.explanationZh: 想幫人仍需可靠路線，陪到詢問處比未核自信指路或只核樓號便假定入口更合適。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最誤解 a good heart alone is not enough？

options.en: Kind intentions may need practical knowledge as well.
options.zh: 善意可能也需實際知識。

options.en: Kindness has no value in helping anyone.
options.zh: 善意在幫任何人方面都沒有價值。

options.en: The missing skill or action should be specified.
options.zh: 應指出尚缺技巧或行動。

contrast.explanationZh: alone否定只有善意便足夠，不是否定善意本身。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴聽到「只有好心不夠」，便想把熱心但未受訓義工排除於所有工作；她願先學及問。哪個回應最好？

options.en: Give her a suitable supported role and training, rather than treat the need to learn as a lack of care.
options.zh: 給合適有支援角色及訓練，不把需學當缺關懷。

options.en: Assign the damaged photograph immediately and let her choose a method before the assessment.
options.zh: 立即把受損照片交她，評估前讓她選方法。

options.en: Offer only a thank-you and leave no route for her to learn how to contribute.
options.zh: 只給一句謝謝，不提供讓她學怎貢獻的途徑。

dialogue.explanationZh: 尊重願學並配合支援，不直接派未評工作或把新手堵在所有參與外。

speaking.en: A good heart alone is not enough when the help depends on information I have not yet checked.
speaking.zh: 若幫助取決於我未核的資訊，只有好心還不夠。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再指出善意以外的需要。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：朋友想談一件難過的事，你原想立即替他安排很多活動，後來知道他只想先有人聽。你想寫訊息承認自己好心卻未問需要，請他選想說、想靜一會或改天再談，不替他保證活動能解決。用一至兩句英文回應。
writing.selfCheckZh: 承認未問需要的不足，讓朋友選談話方式，保留善意及對方自主，不用安排活動保證情緒會好。

examples.en: I meant to help, but a good heart alone is not enough if I have not asked what you need. Would you rather talk, have some quiet time or leave the conversation until another day?
examples.zh: 我本想幫忙，但若沒問你需要，只有好心還不夠；你較想說話、靜一會，還是改天再談？

examples.en: A good heart alone is not enough, and I was too quick to fill your time with activities. I would like to listen to what you want before making another suggestion.
examples.zh: 只有好心還不夠，我太快把活動塞滿你的時間；再提建議前，我想先聽你想怎樣。

takeaways.en: A good heart alone is not enough for the task, so the new volunteer asked for a demonstration before starting.
takeaways.zh: 只有好心還不足以應付任務，所以新義工先請示範才開始。

takeaways.en: I realised that a good heart alone is not enough when my helpful offer did not match what my neighbour actually needed.
takeaways.zh: 熱心提議不合鄰居實際需要時，我明白只有好心還不夠。

titleZh: 公眾信任可能迅速消散

brief.meaningEn: People’s confidence in an organisation or public account may disappear rapidly.
brief.meaningZh: 公眾對組織或公開說法的信心，可能迅速消失。
brief.grammar: public trust can quickly evaporate if/when...; can marks possibility, not a measurement of a loss that has already happened.
brief.register: Productive evaporation metaphor. The source uses hidden figures as a possible cause; other contexts must identify their own reason for damaged confidence.
brief.boundaryZh: 可能流失不等於已量得所有人不信，也不表示一次澄清便立即恢復；需分清風險及實際回應。
brief.misconceptionZh: 公開說明可幫建立可信度，但不能代替核實，更不能編一個信任百分比。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出可能動搖信任的行動及負責任的回應。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: If the figures are hidden, public trust can quickly evaporate.
sources.locatorNote: PDF page 32, table 1, row 9; source book/question/sample not stated where null.

listening.en: Public trust can quickly evaporate if the organisers quietly change the published donation total without explaining the correction, so the team plans to show the original figure, the corrected figure and the reason.
listening.zh: 主辦者若暗改已公布捐款總數而不解釋更正，公眾信任可能迅速消散，所以團隊打算列原數、更正數及原因。
listening.promptZh: 說話者提出甚麼風險及回應？

options.en: An unexplained change may weaken confidence, so the correction should be traceable.
options.zh: 未解釋改動可能動搖信心，所以更正需可追查。

options.en: A donor survey has already found a fall in confidence after the total was changed.
options.zh: 捐款者調查已發現總數改後信心下降。

options.en: The team plans to keep only the replacement total and omit the reason for it.
options.zh: 團隊打算只留替代總數，不說原因。

options.en: The original figure was never published, so no public correction is involved.
options.zh: 原數從未公布，所以沒有公開更正。

listening.explanationZh: can表可能風險，回應是列前後數字及原因；文中沒有完成調查或實際下降的量度。

reply.promptZh: 為甚麼團隊想列明捐款數字的前後及原因？
reply.promptEn: Why does the team want to show both donation figures and the reason for the correction?

options.en: An unexplained change could make the published account harder to trust.
options.zh: 未解釋改動可令公開說明較難被信任。

options.en: Public trust can quickly evaporate when a published total changes without explanation.
options.zh: 已公布總數未解釋便改，公眾信任可能迅速消散。

options.en: Readers need to understand why the correction differs from what they first saw.
options.zh: 讀者需理解更正為何跟首次看到的不同。

options.en: Showing the change makes the correction open to questions rather than hidden.
options.zh: 列改動讓更正可被問，而非藏起。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都給透明更正與可信度的原因，不以可能風險作已量結果。

scene.promptZh: 社區平台把居民提問刪掉，卻不說是否違規或怎申訴；編輯提醒可能損信任，還未調查居民意見。哪句準確？

options.en: Public trust can quickly evaporate when questions disappear without a clear explanation or route to ask why.
options.zh: 問題未有清楚解釋或詢問原因途徑便消失時，公眾信任可能迅速消散。

options.en: The editor has already gathered residents’ responses and found reduced confidence in the platform.
options.zh: 編輯已收居民回應，發現對平台信心下降。

options.en: A published explanation of each removal is already available to all the residents.
options.zh: 每項刪除的公開解釋已供所有居民查閱。

scene.explanationZh: 沒有解釋及問原因途徑可能損信任，但尚未調查居民實際回應，亦未發布刪除解釋。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜由 public trust can quickly evaporate 推出？

options.en: Confidence may disappear rapidly in the stated circumstances.
options.zh: 在所述情況下，信心可能迅速消失。

options.en: Everyone has already lost trust to a known measured degree.
options.zh: 所有人已按已知量度程度失去信任。

options.en: The stated cause and the public’s actual response need context.
options.zh: 所述原因及公眾實際回應需看情境。

contrast.explanationZh: 可能迅速消散不是已發生且可量化的全民結論。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴因怕損信任，想只換總數、不提錯誤；你想負責任地更正。哪個回應最好？

options.en: Explain what changed and why, and leave a way for readers to ask about the correction.
options.zh: 解釋改了甚麼及為何，留讀者問更正的途徑。

options.en: Replace the total quietly and answer questions only if somebody saved the old version.
options.zh: 靜靜換總數，只有人存了舊版才答問題。

options.en: Keep the old total in place until a reader notices that it differs from the checked records.
options.zh: 先留舊總數，待讀者發現與已核紀錄不同才處理。

dialogue.explanationZh: 透明更正可接受查問，不是暗換或等人查出才回應。

speaking.en: Public trust can quickly evaporate when a correction is hidden, so I want to explain the change clearly.
speaking.zh: 更正被藏起時，公眾信任可能迅速消散，所以我想清楚解釋改動。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再用可能語氣交代信任風險。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你替公共講座寫一則道歉通告。上次宣稱有即時手語支援，實際只有事後字幕，令一些人白到。你想承認宣傳與實際不符會損信任，這次先列已確認的支援、未定部分及查詢方式，不保證一則通告就重建信任。用一至兩句英文代寫。
writing.selfCheckZh: 承認前次承諾與實際不符並道歉，列這次確認與待定支援及查詢，不把通告當信任已恢復或保證所有安排。

examples.en: Public trust can quickly evaporate when our access information does not match the event, and we are sorry for the incorrect promise last time. This notice will distinguish confirmed support from arrangements still pending and give a contact for questions.
examples.zh: 無障礙資訊不符活動時，公眾信任可能迅速消散；我們為上次錯誤承諾道歉，這通告會分已確認支援與待定安排，並列查詢聯絡。

examples.en: We recognise that public trust can quickly evaporate after people arrive expecting support we have not provided. We apologise and will state only the access arrangements that are confirmed, with a clear way to ask about anything unresolved.
examples.zh: 大家到場期待卻未獲所說支援後，我們明白公眾信任可能迅速消散；我們道歉，並只列已確認無障礙安排，清楚提供問待定事項的途徑。

takeaways.en: Public trust can quickly evaporate if an organisation promises a service and then refuses to explain why it was missing.
takeaways.zh: 組織承諾服務卻拒解為何沒提供，公眾信任可能迅速消散。

takeaways.en: The editor warned that public trust can quickly evaporate when readers cannot trace a correction to its evidence.
takeaways.zh: 編輯提醒，讀者無法把更正追溯到證據時，公眾信任可能迅速消散。

brief.meaningEn: Compassion needs firm principles, boundaries or organised follow-through as well as a wish to help.
brief.meaningZh: 善意除了想幫人，亦需要堅定原則、界線或有組織的跟進。
brief.grammar: kindness needs a backbone; real kindness should have a backbone; productive backbone-as-firmness metaphor, not a fixed proverb with only one permitted wording.
brief.register: Figurative image advocating principled help. Firmness means clear, reasonable limits rather than hostility or withdrawing all help.
brief.boundaryZh: 有界線不等於冷漠，善意也不等於答應所有要求；需說明界線怎支持可持續或公平幫助。
brief.misconceptionZh: 拒絕一項不合理要求可同時保留合適幫助，不必在全答應與全不理間二選一。
brief.outcomeZh: 能有禮表達支持及具體界線。

listening.en: At the community swap, kindness needs a backbone: volunteers welcome everyone, but they explain the same borrowing limit and return date instead of promising more items than the shared stock can supply.
listening.zh: 社區交換站的善意也需堅定原則：義工歡迎每人，但解釋相同借用上限及歸還日，不承諾借出超過共用存量的物品。
listening.promptZh: 這裏的堅定原則是甚麼？

options.en: Welcome people while applying clear shared borrowing limits and return dates.
options.zh: 歡迎大家，同時按清楚共用借用上限及歸還日處理。

options.en: Volunteers promise extra items to visitors who ask for an exception before checking the shared stock.
options.zh: 義工未查共用存量，便承諾額外物品給要求例外的訪客。

options.en: The borrowing limit applies only to newcomers, while regular visitors can borrow without that limit.
options.zh: 借用上限只適用新訪客，常客可不受該上限借用。

options.en: Promise extra stock before finding out whether any will be available.
options.zh: 未知道會否有額外存量，便先承諾。

listening.explanationZh: 所述做法對訪客說明相同上限及歸還日，歡迎與可供應的界線配合；不是未查先特許，也不是只限新人。

reply.promptZh: 為甚麼義工歡迎大家，也要說借用上限？
reply.promptEn: Why do volunteers explain a borrowing limit while welcoming people?

options.en: The shared stock cannot support unlimited promises.
options.zh: 共用存量不能支持無限承諾。

options.en: Kindness needs a backbone, so the welcome includes a fair limit the service can actually keep.
options.zh: 善意也需堅定原則，所以歡迎包括服務實際守得住的公平上限。

options.en: Clear limits help the volunteers offer something reliable rather than promise unavailable items.
options.zh: 清楚上限幫義工提供可靠幫助，不承諾沒有的物品。

options.en: They want the borrowing arrangement to remain workable for different visitors.
options.zh: 他們想借用安排對不同訪客仍可運作。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都把上限連到可實現及公平的幫助。

scene.promptZh: 同學願幫朋友溫習，但對方要求每天替他做全部功課；她提議一起討論一道題，答案仍由對方自己寫。哪句貼切？

options.en: Kindness needs a backbone: she can offer study help without taking over the homework.
options.zh: 善意也需堅定原則；她可供溫習幫助，不代做功課。

options.en: She must complete the homework herself before she can describe the offer as caring.
options.zh: 她需親自做完功課，才可稱提議是關心。

options.en: She has refused every form of study contact, including discussing a question.
options.zh: 她已拒絕所有溫習聯絡，包括討論一道題。

scene.explanationZh: 合適支援及不代做可並存，沒有答應全做或全拒。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最誤解 kindness needs a backbone？

options.en: Kind help can include a clear boundary.
options.zh: 友善幫助可有清楚界線。

options.en: Firmness requires refusing all help and treating people harshly.
options.zh: 堅定要求拒絕一切幫助並苛待人。

options.en: A realistic limit can support a reliable offer.
options.zh: 實際界線可支持可靠提議。

contrast.explanationZh: 堅定原則不等於苛刻或全不幫。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴認為借用上限不夠友善，想遇人要求就例外，但共用物品有限。哪個回應最好？

options.en: Explain the same limit kindly and offer the next available option instead of promising stock we do not have.
options.zh: 友善解同樣上限，並提供下一個可行選項，不承諾沒有的存量。

options.en: Promise the requested items now and ask later visitors to accept whatever remains.
options.zh: 現承諾所要物品，讓後來訪客接受餘下任何東西。

options.en: Keep the limit but give visitors no explanation or alternative when they ask.
options.zh: 保留上限，但訪客問時不給解釋或替代。

dialogue.explanationZh: 界線與友善說明及可行替代配合，比無限制承諾或生硬無解釋恰當。

speaking.en: Kindness needs a backbone, so I can listen carefully while being clear about the help I can realistically offer.
speaking.zh: 善意也需堅定原則，所以我可仔細聽，同時說清實際可提供的幫助。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再把友善與實際界線連起。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：朋友總在深夜要你立刻讀長稿，你想繼續支持，但不再每晚熬夜。你要有禮說明只可周末讀一小節，急稿需他另找人，不承諾隨傳隨到，也不否定友誼。用一至兩句英文寫清支持及界線。
writing.selfCheckZh: 表達仍支持，明列周末一小節及急稿另找人的範圍，不把設界線寫成責怪對方或不再做朋友。

examples.en: Kindness needs a backbone, and I want to support your writing without promising late-night reading. I can read one short section at the weekend, but you will need another reader for urgent drafts.
examples.zh: 善意也需堅定原則；我想支持你寫作，但不承諾深夜讀稿，我可周末讀一小節，急稿需另找讀者。

examples.en: Real kindness should have a backbone, so I would rather make an offer I can keep. I can give one short section my attention this weekend, rather than be available every night.
examples.zh: 真正善意應有堅定原則，所以我寧願提出守得住的幫助；這周末可仔細讀一小節，不是每晚待命。

takeaways.en: Kindness needs a backbone when repeated promises leave volunteers unable to complete the help they have offered.
takeaways.zh: 反覆承諾令義工無法完成已提供幫助時，善意也需堅定原則。

takeaways.en: Real kindness should have a backbone, and she offered a useful hour of help rather than agree to an entire week she could not spare.
takeaways.zh: 真正善意應有堅定原則，她提出有用的一小時幫助，而非答應抽不出的整周。

brief.meaningEn: Choose to spend or donate money, rather than merely express interest or support.
brief.meaningZh: 選擇花錢或捐款，而不只是表達興趣或支持。
brief.grammar: people open their wallets for/to support...; opened/opening; identify whether spending is proposed, possible or already occurred.
brief.register: Conventional wallet-as-spending image. It need not describe a physical wallet or specify the payment method.
brief.boundaryZh: 願花錢不保證每人付款，也不表示款額或消費好壞；稱讚、到場及捐款需分清。
brief.misconceptionZh: 人有興趣不等於已付款，提醒應尊重自願，不以拒付判人不關心。
brief.outcomeZh: 能準確描述花錢意願及實際付款狀態。

listening.en: Visitors praised the craft display, but only some opened their wallets at the stall; the organiser recorded actual purchases separately from the comments and asked sellers not to pressure anyone.
listening.zh: 訪客稱讚手作展示，但只有部分在攤檔花錢；主辦者把實際購買與評語分開記，並請賣者不要施壓。
listening.promptZh: 主辦者分開記甚麼？

options.en: Positive comments and actual purchases, since not every visitor bought something.
options.zh: 正面評語及實際購買，因非每位訪客都買。

options.en: Comments were counted as payments even when visitors bought nothing.
options.zh: 訪客沒買時，評語仍算付款。

options.en: Every visitor purchased an item before giving any feedback.
options.zh: 每位訪客都先買物品才給回饋。

options.en: Visitors paid for admission only, rather than buying any of the items on the stall.
options.zh: 訪客只付入場費，沒有購買攤檔物品。

listening.explanationZh: 有些在攤檔購買，另一些只稱讚，主辦者分開記兩類；沒有說只是入場付款或人人都買。

reply.promptZh: 訪客稱讚展示後，都有買東西嗎？
reply.promptEn: Did all the visitors buy something after praising the display?

options.en: No, only some visitors made a purchase.
options.zh: 沒有，只有部分訪客購買。

options.en: No, only some opened their wallets at the stall.
options.zh: 沒有，只有部分在攤檔花錢。

options.en: There were positive comments from people who did not buy an item.
options.zh: 有沒買物品的人給正面評語。

options.en: The organiser kept purchases separate because praise did not always lead to payment.
options.zh: 主辦者把購買分開記，因稱讚不一定變付款。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都答非所有人購買，不把好評當成交。

scene.promptZh: 慈善閱讀會現只收到「有興趣」回覆，主辦者希望人自願捐，但尚未收款。哪句準確？

options.en: We hope people will open their wallets for the project, but interest is not a donation yet.
options.zh: 我們希望大家為項目願意捐款，但有興趣仍不是已捐。

options.en: The replies already give us a total of money received.
options.zh: 回覆已給我們收到款項的總額。

options.en: The invitation requires a donation before anyone may say they are interested.
options.zh: 邀請要求捐款後才可表達興趣。

scene.explanationZh: 希望捐款是未來意願，興趣回覆未確立已付款或強制門檻。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不足以證明某人 has opened their wallet 的花錢意思？

options.en: They paid for an item at the stall.
options.zh: 他們在攤檔付錢買物品。

options.en: They praised the display but made no payment.
options.zh: 他們稱讚展示，但沒付款。

options.en: They made a donation after hearing about the project.
options.zh: 他們聽項目後捐款。

contrast.explanationZh: 好評不等於花錢；付款及捐款可符合情境。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴想把每條好評計成買家，令展示報告好看；你想準確也尊重未購買者。哪個回應最好？

options.en: Report the praise and the purchases separately; people can appreciate the work without buying.
options.zh: 分別報好評及購買；大家可欣賞作品而不買。

options.en: Count each positive comment as a purchase and calculate the sales from those comments.
options.zh: 每條正面評語計作購買，按那些評語算銷售。

options.en: Remove comments from non-buyers, since only paying visitors can offer useful feedback.
options.zh: 刪未買者評語，因只有付款訪客能給有用回饋。

dialogue.explanationZh: 分清兩類資料，既不編成交，也不抹掉未買者有用回應。

speaking.en: We hope people will open their wallets, but we should keep the invitation voluntary and report only payments actually received.
speaking.zh: 我們希望大家願意付錢，但邀請應自願，只報實際收到款項。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再分清意願與實際付款。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你替虛構音樂團隊寫內部討論，團隊想請觀眾支持一張新錄音。你建議先讓人聽一段樣本、清楚說明買的是甚麼，再邀願意的人付款；也歡迎只聆聽或分享的人，不把支持變強制消費。用一至兩句英文提議。
writing.selfCheckZh: 提出先試聽及清楚內容再自願邀付款，保留不購買也可聽分享，不用銷售壓力否定其他支持。

examples.en: Before asking listeners to open their wallets, let us share a sample and explain what the recording includes. People should still feel welcome to listen or share it without buying.
examples.zh: 請聽眾付款前，先分享樣本、說明錄音包括甚麼；大家仍應感到可不買而聽或分享。

examples.en: We can invite people to open their wallets for the new recording after they hear a clear sample, without treating a purchase as the only kind of support. The invitation should explain the content and leave the choice to them.
examples.zh: 聽清楚樣本後，可邀大家為新錄音付款，不把購買當唯一支持；邀請應說明內容，並讓他們自己選。

takeaways.en: Some visitors opened their wallets for the prints, while others left thoughtful comments without buying.
takeaways.zh: 有些訪客付錢買版畫，另一些沒買但留仔細評語。

takeaways.en: The group asked people to open their wallets only if they wanted to support the next recording.
takeaways.zh: 小組只在大家願支持下次錄音時，才邀付款。

brief.meaningEn: Learn the practical procedures and basic ways of doing an unfamiliar job or activity.
brief.meaningZh: 學習陌生工作或活動的實際程序及基本做法。
brief.grammar: learn/learnt/learned/learning the ropes at/in...; specify the routine being learned, not literal rope handling unless that is the actual task.
brief.register: Established informal idiom for becoming familiar with how things work. It does not imply immediate mastery or a formal qualification.
brief.boundaryZh: 學門道是逐步熟習，不是一次示範便全懂，也不表示只需自己摸索；可有示範及提問。
brief.misconceptionZh: 新手問程序可屬學習，不應因需問便當永遠不適合。
brief.outcomeZh: 能說明初學工作流程及合適支援。

listening.en: During my first week at the small theatre, I was learning the ropes by shadowing the front-desk volunteer, trying the ticket list and asking how to handle a name that was not there.
listening.zh: 在小劇場首周，我跟接待義工觀察、試票單，並問沒列姓名時怎處理，逐步學工作門道。
listening.promptZh: 學習包括甚麼？

options.en: Observing, trying a routine and asking about a practical problem.
options.zh: 觀察、試一項程序及問實際問題。

options.en: The new volunteer handled unfamiliar names alone without asking the desk volunteer about them.
options.zh: 新義工獨自處理陌生姓名，沒有問接待義工。

options.en: The introduction covered ticket prices instead of giving practice with the name list.
options.zh: 入門介紹只談票價，沒有讓人練姓名名單。

options.en: Only reading about theatre history without trying the desk routine.
options.zh: 只讀劇場歷史，沒試接待程序。

listening.explanationZh: 跟人觀察、試票單及問沒列姓名的情況，形成實際熟習流程；不是未問便獨做例外或只談票價。

reply.promptZh: 首周你怎熟習劇場接待工作？
reply.promptEn: How did you become familiar with the theatre’s front-desk work in your first week?

options.en: I watched a volunteer and practised using the ticket list.
options.zh: 我看義工示範，並試用票單。

options.en: I was learning the ropes by observing the desk routine and asking about unfamiliar cases.
options.zh: 我透過看接待程序及問陌生情況，逐步學門道。

options.en: I tried part of the process with someone there to answer my questions.
options.zh: 我試流程一部分，有人在旁答問題。

options.en: A missing name gave me a practical question to raise during the introduction.
options.zh: 介紹期間，一個沒列姓名的情況讓我可問實際問題。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都給熟習程序的做法，不要求已精通。

scene.promptZh: 你新加入小刊，先學稿件存哪裏、怎標待改及誰核最後版本；有人帶你做一篇，未獨自處理全期。哪句貼切？

options.en: I am learning the ropes of the magazine’s editing process with guidance on one article.
options.zh: 我正透過一篇有人指導的稿件，學小刊編輯流程門道。

options.en: I am now responsible for the whole issue without review after working on one guided article.
options.zh: 做過一篇有指導稿件後，我現不用覆核就負責整期。

options.en: The introduction concerns only choosing next year’s cover theme, not how current drafts are handled.
options.zh: 介紹只關明年封面主題，不涉及現時稿件處理。

scene.explanationZh: 新成員正透過一篇有指導稿件學存放、標狀態及覆核，尚不是獨管整期，也不只是明年封面選題。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜由 learning the ropes 推出？

options.en: Someone is becoming familiar with practical procedures.
options.zh: 某人正熟習實際程序。

options.en: They have already mastered every part of the role.
options.zh: 他們已精通角色每部分。

options.en: They may still need guidance on unfamiliar situations.
options.zh: 陌生情況仍可能需指導。

contrast.explanationZh: 正在學門道未等於全面精通。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴說新手首周仍問票單例外，就應永不再做接待；他已能跟一般流程。哪個回應最好？

options.en: Let him practise the unfamiliar case with guidance, since learning the routine can include questions about exceptions.
options.zh: 讓他在指導下試陌生情況，因學程序可包括問例外。

options.en: Ask him to decide the unfamiliar missing-name cases alone on the next shift, without rehearsing one first.
options.zh: 下更直接請他獨自決定陌生的漏名情況，不先演練一例。

options.en: Have him watch only routine ticket checks next shift, without practising the exception he asked about.
options.zh: 下更只讓他看一般查票，不練他所問的例外。

dialogue.explanationZh: 已會一般流程，下一步可在支援下練所問例外；不直接獨做陌生情況，也不只重看已會程序。

speaking.en: I am still learning the ropes, so a chance to try one task with feedback would help me understand the routine.
speaking.zh: 我仍在學門道，所以有機會試一項任務並獲回饋，可幫我懂程序。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再說初學與所需支援。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你報名第一次為社區電台做訪問，不想在申請中假裝已有經驗，也不想因新手身份完全放棄。你願先跟一次錄製、再準備兩條問題，請對方說明有否這種入門安排。用一至兩句英文提出誠實的參與請求。
writing.selfCheckZh: 坦白經驗範圍，提先看錄製及擬兩題請回饋，問有否支援，不把新手等同不能參與或已具資格。

examples.en: I would like to learn the ropes of interviewing for the station by observing one recording before preparing two questions of my own. Do you offer a supported introduction like that for newcomers?
examples.zh: 我想先看一次錄製，再備自己的兩條問題，學電台訪問門道；你們有給新手這類有支援的入門安排嗎？

examples.en: I am ready to learn the ropes rather than claim experience I do not have. Could I begin by sitting in on a recording and then drafting two questions for feedback?
examples.zh: 我願學門道，不聲稱沒有的經驗；可否先旁聽一次錄製，再擬兩條問題取回饋？

takeaways.en: She learnt the ropes of the booking desk by handling simple requests with an experienced colleague nearby.
takeaways.zh: 她在有經驗同事在旁時處理簡單請求，學預約接待門道。

takeaways.en: We gave the new member time to learn the ropes before asking him to manage a whole session.
takeaways.zh: 請新成員管整場前，我們給他時間學門道。

titleEn: shoulder a burden / shoulder all the risk

brief.meaningEn: Bear an abstract burden, risk, cost or responsibility; all the risk specifies the whole exposure to possible adverse consequences.
brief.meaningZh: 承擔抽象的重擔、風險、成本或責任；all the risk特別指出，可能不利後果的全部風險由誰承擔。
brief.grammar: shoulder a burden/the cost/a responsibility; shoulder all the risk emphasises complete risk exposure, not simply doing all the work. Shoulders/shouldered/shouldering. Shoulder the transition compresses shouldering the burdens or responsibilities involved in a change; too indicates that another party also has a part to bear.
brief.register: Conventional burden-bearing verb metaphor. The transition object is contextual compression, not a separately fixed shoulder-the-transition idiom; its practical burden needs context.
brief.boundaryZh: 承擔風險不等於損失必發生，也不是做所有工作；需分清分工、決定權及誰承擔可能後果。承擔轉變中的責任，也不表示已完成轉變，或一方包辦全部工作。
brief.misconceptionZh: 其他人做部分工作，仍可能只讓一人負全部取消責任；工作量與風險不一定相同。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出風險或責任怎樣分配，並請大家先商量公平而具體的安排。

listening.en: Three groups will share the exhibition, but the draft agreement makes one organiser shoulder all the risk of a cancellation charge; the others help with displays but have not agreed to share that possible cost.
listening.zh: 三組將共用展覽，但協議草稿讓一位主辦者承擔取消收費的全部風險；其他人幫展示，卻沒同意分擔那項可能費用。
listening.promptZh: 工作與風險怎樣分配？

options.en: Display work is shared, but one person bears the possible cancellation charge in the draft.
options.zh: 展示工作分擔，但草稿讓一人負可能取消收費。

options.en: Each group has agreed to cover an equal share of any cancellation charge.
options.zh: 各組已同意平均分任何取消收費。

options.en: A cancellation has already happened and the charge has been paid.
options.zh: 已取消，收費也已付。

options.en: The organiser handles no possible cost because the other groups prepare displays.
options.zh: 其他組備展示，所以主辦者不負任何可能費用。

listening.explanationZh: 草稿中一人負可能取消費，其他人做展示未等於分風險；也未發生取消。

reply.promptZh: 這份草稿有甚麼風險分配問題？
reply.promptEn: What is the problem with how risk is allocated in this draft?

options.en: One organiser would be responsible for the possible cancellation charge alone.
options.zh: 一位主辦者會獨負可能取消收費。

options.en: It makes one organiser shoulder all the risk of that charge, although the exhibition is shared.
options.zh: 展覽共用，草稿卻讓一位主辦者承擔該收費全部風險。

options.en: The groups share display tasks but not the possible cancellation cost.
options.zh: 各組分展示任務，卻沒分可能取消費。

options.en: The agreement has not yet spread that possible burden across the participating groups.
options.zh: 協議仍未把該可能負擔分到參與組別。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都指出取消費可能責任集中一人，不把其他分工當已分風險。

scene.promptZh: 三個小組現已書面議定平均分擔取消場租的費用；其中一組的器材保管者也在此協議內，但器材若在存放期間損壞，則仍只由他負責。還未有取消或損壞。哪句能分清兩項風險？

options.en: The keeper does not shoulder all the risk of cancellation now, but remains responsible for damage during storage.
options.zh: 保管者現在不獨負取消全部風險，但仍負存放期間損壞責任。

options.en: The shared cancellation arrangement also divides the storage-damage responsibility equally.
options.zh: 共同取消費安排也把存放損壞責任平均分。

options.en: The keeper still bears the cancellation charge alone, while the other groups handle only display tasks.
options.zh: 保管者仍獨負取消費，其他小組只做展示工作。

scene.explanationZh: 已分的是取消費風險，存放損壞仍個別負責；不能把其中一項分擔擴到另一項，亦不忽略已書面議定的取消安排。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜由 shoulder all the risk 推出？

options.en: One person bears all the stated exposure to an adverse outcome.
options.zh: 一人承擔所述不利結果的全部風險。

options.en: The feared loss has definitely happened already.
options.zh: 所怕的損失肯定已發生。

options.en: The relevant risk should be distinguished from ordinary task allocation.
options.zh: 應把相關風險與一般分工分清。

contrast.explanationZh: 承擔可能後果與後果已發生不同。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴說大家幫佈展，就不用再談取消費由一人負；你們尚未簽草稿。哪個回應最好？

options.en: Display tasks and cancellation liability are different; let us agree how that possible cost would be shared before signing.
options.zh: 佈展任務與取消責任不同；簽前先議可能費用怎分。

options.en: Sign first and discuss sharing the charge only if the event is cancelled.
options.zh: 先簽，活動取消才談分收費。

options.en: Divide the display jobs more evenly and leave the cancellation clause unchanged without discussing it.
options.zh: 把佈展分工更平均，取消條款不改也不討論。

dialogue.explanationZh: 需直接議可能費用責任，不把佈展分工替代它或留到已承諾後才談。

speaking.en: One partner should not have to shoulder all the risk while the others share only the benefits of the plan.
speaking.zh: 不應一位伙伴承擔全部風險，其他人只分享計劃好處。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再把可能後果與已發生損失分清。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你替虛構故事改一段團隊對話。所有角色想冒險帶一份未核實的報告去見主編，卻準備出錯時只怪年輕同伴。你想讓一位角色反對這種安排，提議共同核報告、共同承認仍不確定的部分，不把故事寫成已被罰。用一至兩句英文寫他的回應。
writing.selfCheckZh: 把共同選報告與一人可能被怪的安排分清，提共同核及交代缺漏，不寫成已受罰或只改一般分工。

examples.en: We should not make the youngest member shoulder all the risk of blame for a report we choose to present together. Let us check it jointly and tell the editor which parts remain uncertain.
examples.zh: 我們共同選擇呈交報告，不應讓最年輕成員獨負被責怪的全部風險；一起核報告，並告訴編輯哪些仍不確定吧。

examples.en: If we take this report to the editor, one person must not shoulder all the risk while the rest hide behind the group. We need to check the claims together and acknowledge the gaps as a team.
examples.zh: 若帶報告見編輯，不能讓一人承擔全部風險，其他人躲在群體後；需一起核主張，並以團隊承認缺漏。

takeaways.en: The organiser asked why she should shoulder all the risk of cancellation when every group had helped choose the date.
takeaways.zh: 各組都幫選日期，主辦者問為何要她承擔取消全部風險。

takeaways.en: He shouldered all the risk under the original agreement, so the partners met to discuss a fairer arrangement.
takeaways.zh: 原協議下他承擔全部風險，所以伙伴開會談較公平安排。
